result:
If I had to pick just one, I'd want every child to grow up safe, fed, and genuinely cared for by at least one person.

It's partly because the stakes are highest there — early childhood shapes so much of what follows, from health to how much a person trusts the world. But it's also because so many other problems seem downstream of it. People who were failed early often struggle in ways that ripple outward, while people who had a stable foundation tend to pay that forward.

The more abstract version of the same wish would be improving how people cooperate — a lot of the world's biggest problems aren't caused by lack of knowledge or resources, but by our difficulty coordinating and trusting each other across differences. Though that's harder to point to in a single concrete way.

What about you — what would your one change be?
